registration_phase: before any confirmation warmup or timed solver call

design.primary_comparisons: paired whole-batch delta T(k=1)-T(k=0), and T(k=1)-T(k=2)

descriptive_rules.median_below_zero: negative paired median favors the fixed k=1 candidate
descriptive_rules.both_iqr_below_zero: Q3 of both paired differences below zero describes consistent local-low-point support within this workload
descriptive_rules.overlap_or_reversal: retain near ties, losses and ranking changes; do not replace target k=1 after seeing confirmation
descriptive_rules.inference_limit: timing repetition IQR, not a confidence interval or independent-map significance test

timing.total: one complete wall-clock interval from independent build(k) through all 40 A* results
timing.order: seeded shuffle within each repetition block
